core_question: How do I fix cracked, peeling caulk around a bathtub? (secondary: How do I fix leather shoes that have dried out and started to crack?)
answer_summary: Remove the old caulk with a scraper or caulk-removal tool, clean and dry the seam, then apply a new bead of 100% silicone caulk and smooth it with a wet finger or tool.; after the topic shift: Clean the leather, then massage in a leather conditioner or oil such as neatsfoot oil to replenish lost moisture and restore flexibility, buffing off the excess once absorbed.
persona: skeptical and testy; writing in full careful sentences
